mentions.name: Utility Industry Consulting Toolkit
mentions.description: This project productizes critical consulting tool sets for the utility industry so the team can stop rebuilding the same deliverables on every engagement. It is being bootstrapped as a stealth group inside a Fortune 500 company with two collaborators, already proven out with ad hoc tooling, and is currently the most profitable group within the department.
mentions.problem: Consulting teams repeat themselves across engagements, re-doing essentially the same 90% of work for every client in the industry.
mentions.audience: Consulting clients in the utility industry, whose needs overlap ~90% across engagements
mentions.source_excerpt: Trying to productize critical consulting tool sets in the utility industry so we can stop repeating ourselves for the 100th consulting engagement.

evidence.value: Trying to productize critical consulting tool sets in the utility industry so we can stop repeating ourselves for the 100th consulting engagement.
